Q6113.reason: Common-law arson requires malicious burning, and forgetting a stove that starts an accidental fire shows negligence at most, not malice.

Q5966.reason: The cardiac cycle is standardly defined as the alternation of diastole (relaxation and filling) and systole (contraction and ejection).

Q8294.reason: Ice is less dense than liquid water because hydrogen bonding forms an open crystalline lattice, so increasing pressure favors the denser liquid and gives the negative slope.
